sources.note: No account by this name; only firms in Tamworth (a different spelling).
Not a financial relation: the phrase is used only for projects of the Pennsylvania Keystone Recreation, Park and Conservation Fund, which plays no part here.
No institution by this name; only Orrell Water Park and Correl Glen nature reserves.
No fund by this name; only Salt Funds Management and the Saltire Prize.
No account product by this name; only people and firms with similar names.

notes: Made-up class, relation (as in finance-insert-0007, transitive) and object. The fourth query runs the rule backwards (contraposition), still in DL: Tamsworth ⊑ ∃keystone_funded_by.{Orrel}.
